## Story DD Coverage

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/data/visual-eval-corpus/ directory with ≥40 fixture subdirectories.

Distribution: 10 implementation_drift, 10 design_flaw, 10 mixed, 10 uncertain = 40 total (≥10 per class).

Each fixture-NNN/ directory:
- screenshot.png: a minimal 10x10 PNG (1x1 pixel repeated or generated via Python imaging)
- design_manifest.json: {"fixture_id": "fixture-NNN", "attribution_class": "<class>", "description": "..."}
- labels/ subdirectory (empty, populated by task-3)

Create tests/visual_eval/test_class_balance.py:
- test_corpus_size_and_balance: walks corpus, groups by attribution_class, asserts total ≥40 and each class ≥10
- test_every_fixture_schema_valid: calls validate_fixture from label_visual_corpus.py on each, asserts all pass

Note: CLAUDE.md invariant on plugins/dso/data/** boundary allowlist. Verify allowlist accepts visual-eval-corpus/ before creating files. If blocked, document as AC amendment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Corpus has ≥40 fixtures with ≥10 per attribution_class
  Verify: pytest tests/visual_eval/test_class_balance.py::test_corpus_size_and_balance -v
- [ ] Every fixture passes schema validation
  Verify: pytest tests/visual_eval/test_class_balance.py::test_every_fixture_schema_valid -v
